title: Reading order
description: One reading order: its masthead and its sections. Ids may be omitted — they are generated on import. See /authoring.md for the friendlier field-name aliases that are also accepted.

id.description: Only present in exported files; ignored on import, where a fresh id is allocated.

titleAccent.description: The tail of the title, printed in the accent colour on its own line.

deck.description: The intro paragraph under the title.

mainLabel.description: What the required part of the list is called. Defaults to "main line".

optionalLabel.description: What everything else is called. Defaults to "optional".

id.description: Unique within the file. Omit it and one is generated.

n.description: The number printed beside the heading. Any string.

core.description: Counts toward the main-line percentage. Defaults to true.

flag.description: Draws a red bar beside the note, for a warning or an aside.

collected.description: Reference data: which trade or omnibus collects it, and the year. Rendered in mono, separately from the note.

s.description: The series name only. Put a disambiguating year in `i`.

url.description: Where to actually read it. Must be http or https; shown as a 'read' button on the row.

alt.description: Tints the row, for when two titles alternate.
